avis.texte: I have been using Youthdrops Gentle Refining Peel for several months, and find it genuinely effective. I use it a couple times a week on my 64 year old face and neck. I have found it very helpful keeping my skin smooth and hydrated, without drying. I am happy to note that my neck is also smooth and doesn't resemble a turkey! Some reviews note the scent being off- putting, but I don't think it's bad, and it very quickly dissipates. It's definitely an overnight treatment to keep on repeat. Highly recommend!

I used tretinoin for years which I thought was helping to heal up my acne scars but since I discovered youth drops I stopped using tret. The youth drops have completely erased my acne scars in 1/4 of the time it would've taken tret to do. I swear I can even notice a difference day to day. It's also working to reduce the hyperpigmentation on my chest. I use youth drops at night and hyper drops during the day. These products are incredibly effective. Like magic.
Has cleared up some redness on my cheeks and overall looks more even. Both photos I'm just wearing a tinted moisturizer. Tingles a little but not painful.

I recieved a sample of this and loved it so much, I purchased the full sized tube. I'm 65 and take excellent care of my skin. It shows! This product really smoothes my skin. It's light weight, non greasy and a must have for me.
Gently clears my face every time I use it overnight. Best product I have found!

I received this in a sample size from my Ipsy glam bag and I have been obsessed. After using this for about 2 weeks I noticed a difference in my dark spots and the overall glow and clarity of my skin. This is a must if you struggle with dark spots, hyperpigmentation and/or dull skin!
Purchased after receiving a sample tube because the results were so noticeable. My dark spots actually faded! I liked it so much that I purchased extra during the holiday sale to give away!

This was my first purchase from this brand and was kind of on the fence about it. I fell in love with it after the first use. Applied at night and in the morning my skin definitely looked refreshed and slowly. Pretty sure I'll continue buying and keeping it in my rotation.

avis.titre: When I need to pull out the big guns
avis.texte: My skin is generally pretty chill. I'm 40, white and live in the desert so it gets dry and stuff but otherwise is holding up pretty well. But I teach classes about once a month and the night before, I like to use this serum. My skin looks so nice for like 2 days afterwards! I was given a little travel size so I use it sparingly, but MAN, does it work. It improves the texture, the overall color tone, and I just have this *glow*. I only need to put on a little color correcting powder in the morning (I have some broken capillaries that not even this liquid gold can fix) and I'm good to go. I look like I have makeup on! But it's just skincare and a little powder. Love this product. Although, I do have to say it smells pretty bad lol. Not like perfume, thank goodness. It smells like a skin care product that hasn't been perfumed. I'm glad about the lack of perfume and yet it's smelly for a few minutes. I don't care, still love it.
Great product! I loved it when it was Youthdrops. It makes your skin feel great!
I love this product and so does my skin. I am seeing a difference in my dark spots.

avis.titre: Great addition to my evening products
avis.texte: Love that I can use this nightly w/o any irritation, my skin is looking much brighter and has a lovely goal in the am.

I use several Onekind products and love how they make my skin feel and look. I've had issues with some glycolic acids in the past, but the Youthdrops are gentle enough that they don't cause any sort of skin sensitivity and my skin looks amazing when I get up in the morning. I can already tell a difference in firmness and a slight change in some of my dark spots that I expect to get better with consistent use. The smell has not bothered me one bit. One of my favorite skin care brands!!
After a couple of weeks of using this every other night I really noticed a difference in the evenness of my skin tone!

Really like this product a lot. My skin is too sensitive for a lot of more potent exfoliation products. This one is just right, not too harsh. I layer the night cream over it and wake up with super soft skin in the morning. I use this twice a week. Very nice!

Youthdrops do not cause a reaction on my sensitive Celtic skin. I do apply a second serum over it, which dilutes the Youthdrops so I can use it daily. I put an eye cream and moisturizer over that. I'm using Youthdrops on my hands as well. The spots are fading and skin quality has improved.
This product leaves your skin glowing.I always look better in the morning when I use these at night.

I have been a Dream Cream fan for several years. I tried the Youthdrops on a whim and like! The product softens and smooths texture overnight. It's gentle enough for my sensitive skin. The product smell is not my favorite. Very vinegar but it works well enough to earn a spot in my routine.

I haven't been using the Youthdrops long enough for before and after pictures, but I have already noticed a difference in the brightness of my skin. I have sensitive skin and don't even notice much of a tingle after applying. I'm so glad your products are made for sensitive skin. I wasn't sure how my skin would react to the Youthdrops, but am pleasantly surprised. Will continue to use and know I'll see an even bigger improvement.
I am enjoying this serum, my face is looking good. It does well under a night cream.

Curious about Youthdrops? Understandably, with a product called "Youthdrops" you might be wondering if it will damage your skin. Moreover, it might scare you away. Don't worry, however, Youthdrops is a lovely and gentle nighttime serum that will even out your skin tone and give you an undeniable glow. Use every other night before applying a moisturizer. My experience has been wonderful with Youthdrops, as well as with One Kind in general. Please do yourself a favor and pick some up!

I haven't been using this product very long, but it seems to be doing a great job. I'm trying so hard to lighten all the dark spots on my skin and this seems to be helping me reach my goal. I have 3 products that I switch around each night, so when I added this one, I believe it made a difference.

I love one kind love their products. This product feels great will say I've not used it long enough to say it works for sure, but if it's like their other products it will. My only complaint is the smell…. It's about dang unbearable

I have been using Youthdrops Gentle Refining Peel every night for almost a year now. My skin tone has evened out & I wake up with clearer, fresher feeling skin. I absolutely love everything about this product! A must in my beauty routine.

It's like a serum and a moisturizer in one. You can feel it instantly go to work. I can't say enough about how well Youthdrops work especially if you're using the other onekind line as well. Get it, you won't regret it.

avis.titre: Doesn't take much as it c
avis.texte: Doesn't take much as it comes out fast. I had to cut the tip as it got clogged. Good stuff and large bottle for the price. Smell is nice.

avis.titre: I don't know how they do it
avis.texte: I've been using Onekind for a few years now, and every single product they release is incredible. I've been using Youthdrops for a couple of nights now and I love it. After the first night, I woke up and my skin looked more evened out. I'm someone who deals with a lot of redness (I'm a ginger ??

avis.titre: Essential Part of My Nightly routine
avis.texte: I have found that this serum works well under DeamCream to keep my skin looking fresh every morning. I have used it for over a month and it is now routine.

After using this for two weeks, I can definitely tell a difference in how smooth and moisturized my face looks. I just don't particularly like the smell of this product, but will keep using for the great results.
I absolutely LOVE this resurfacing serum-I have tried several different brands and this is the BEST! It works like prescription serums.
The gel glides very easily and smoothly over my face, and a little goes a long way. I instantly feel a little tingle and then add the overnight cream. My face feels so soft!

First of all, I am in love with all the OneKind products I have purchased. I just added Youthdrops to my nightly routine. Because I have rosacea, I was worried that the drops would be too aggressive, but that was not the case. I'm using 3 times a week, starting on my forehead and sides of my face and carrying the residual cream to my cheeks and nose where my rosacea is more predominate. I let it sink in and follow with Moon Drops and Dream Cream...and off to bed! PS: Since using OneKind products I don't need to use my Roseacea prescription Gel as frequently!

The Youthdrops Gentle Refining Peel are an excellent addition to the onekind catalog! I love this product already - I use it every other day under the nighttime Dream cream, and I love the way it makes my skin look/feel the next day. Great product ??

avis.titre: I have used a few times s
avis.texte: I have used a few times so far. Great results, my skin looks refreshed

I have a tendency toward sensitive skin with rosacea as I get older and I was pleasantly surprised this product didn't aggravate that. There was a tingle applying it, but it was actually quite pleasant! I just discovered these products and am eager to see how they work in the long-term. I love discovering excellent products and would so much rather support a small business.

avis.titre: Love it, an all in one, leave on acid peel
avis.texte: It goes on smoothly, with no burning, and you can leave it on. No rinsing necessary. I love it.

Other then a short tingle I absolutely love this product, my skin is generally sensitive so I am working to slowly incorporate it into my routine. Currently I aim for every third day and it's working out well- no irritation!

Other resurfacing acids have been to harsh for my sensitive skin, but this one isn't! Already notice a difference after a few weeks, and definitely noticed when I forgot it while travelling and didn't use it until I got back!
This product is light and feels refreshing on the skin I love the effect it leaves as well. It's great for brightening and moisturizing.

It goes grest with the night dream cream. Apply at night and you skin in am feels so soft. Really nice. I have used the cream before the resurfacing serum cam out. The cream is just as wonderful alone or under makeup. Thank you. Rate a 5
Feeling the glowwww ? goes on light, and melts into the skin perfectly! Not greasy at all I am very impressed Definitely recommend . Give it a try :)

The next morning, I noticed a visible improvement in my pores. They were smaller, my skin was smoother (i.e., dry patches were soft, raised areas with dead skill shrunk down and were clearer), and my overall skin tone continues to improve with each use. I typically use this 2-3 nights a week. I'm not a fan of the smell but I will deal with it for results like these.

I tend to be cautious when it comes to products because I have sensitive skin, but I've been pleasantly surprised by this resurfacing serum. It doesn't irritate my skin but it leaves it feeling smooth and soft in the morning. Definitely worth trying!

avis.titre: Love the feel of my skin in the morning
avis.texte: I use these Youthdrops a couple times a week, paired with the dream cream. In the morning, my skin feels wonderful. The Youthdrops seem like they are definitely working on resurfacing my skin and the dream cream keeps my skin hydrated. I bought these on a bit of a whim after reading some reviews and the proof is in the pudding—they work great together.

I've been using this serum every other night for a few weeks and I can see a difference in my skin's texture and dark spots have faded. I like that I can use it regularly without irritation. Sometimes exfoliating treatments leave my red and splotchy but this one doesn't. I always apply Dream Cream after and I like the two products used together. Great easy nighttime routine!
Been using this for a couple weeks now, and I like it so far. The smell isn't ideal, but if it can continue to smooth out my skin, I can deal with it.

My skin has been looking brighter and smoother. I am using several Onekind products in my nightly routine now and I think it's the winning combination. I have some stubborn dark spots that are slowly fading.
I can feel the acid working but it's not too strong--very nicely balanced! I've been using it on my back too and it is helping keep my skin clear.

I always get red and irritated from exfoliating masks so I was super excited to try this overnight serum instead. So far it's been really gentle on my skin but does the job. My skin seems clearer and softer after a few nights!
